<thought>The spectrum shows a strong M+2 peak (≈33% of the base peak) which matches the natural abundance ratio of ^37Cl to ^35Cl (≈32%). This characteristic pattern uniquely identifies chlorine. No other element shows such a distinctive pattern at these intensities, so chlorine is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['Cl']</final_answer>
